# Configuration reference

Generated from the typed options records in `backend/src/Core/Configuration` (the single source of truth for runtime configuration).
Values differ between environments only through environment variables and the secret store; there are no per-environment settings files.
Hosts validate this schema at startup and refuse to start on missing or invalid values.

Standard variables read by libraries directly (for example `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `ASPNETCORE_URLS`) are not listed here.

## Database

The catalog database, tenant database servers and the database provider.

| Environment variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Database__Provider` | string | yes |  | Database provider for the catalog and every tenant database. Allowed: one of `sqlserver`, `postgresql`. Example: `sqlserver`. |
| `Database__CatalogConnectionString` | string | yes |  | Connection string for the catalog database. Use managed identity (no password) in the cloud. **Secret.** |
| `Database__Servers__default` | map of string | no |  | Base connection string for a tenant server or pool, without a database name. One entry per pool; 'default' is the pool new tenants use. **Secret.** |
| `Database__MaxPoolSize` | integer | no | `50` | Max Pool Size for each tenant connection string. Ceiling: tenants x instances x this value. Allowed: 1–1000. |
| `Database__TenantCacheSeconds` | integer | no | `30` | How long a tenant's resolved connection is cached, in seconds. Allowed: 1–3600. |
| `Database__MigrationParallelism` | integer | no | `4` | How many tenants the Migrator migrates in parallel with --all. Allowed: 1–64. |

## Redis

The Redis-protocol store (Valkey locally) for cache, locks, rate limits and the SignalR backplane.

| Environment variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Redis__ConnectionString` | string | yes |  | StackExchange.Redis connection string. **Secret.** Example: `localhost:6379`. |

## Tenancy

How requests are mapped to tenants.

| Environment variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Tenancy__BaseDomain` | string | yes |  | Base domain: tenants are served at {tenant}.{BaseDomain}, sign-in at login.{BaseDomain}. Allowed: matches `^[a-z0-9.-]+$`. Example: `localhost`. |
